messages:
incident-bot: Pager: HIGH 429 rate detected for /v1/generate across eu-west-1 GPU pool (threshold breached: 15m avg 18% > 5%). Cluster: redwood-gpu-eu-prod. AlertID: GPU_SAT_1936007889.

eric_oncall: ack, looking. seeing rising queue length on hotpath (hotpath-pool-2) — 6k pending requests, 90% GPU utilization on all nodes. digging into autoscaler logs.

ben_sre: fyi CPU fallback already hit capacity earlier, we started sending 429s at edge when token-bucket ran out. this looks like autoscaler didn't spin up new nodes — max_nodes=8, currently at 8.

ciara_prod: customers reporting 429s and long failures on chat endpoints. I'm seeing top customer errors: org-id: rdx-enterprise and rdx-proto. PMs are getting messages. Lina, heads up?

lina_pm: on it. pinging CSMs. What's ETA on mitigation?

jamie_csm: I just informed rdx-enterprise support channel — they see ~30% of calls failing with 429s starting ~10:14UTC. They want an ETA and mitigation.

eric_oncall: quick triage notes: queue backlog originates from a sudden burst of long-seq requests (>=4096 tokens) from a single customer job + normal traffic. Autoscaler didn't scale because cooldown=10m and scale-out policy uses cpu-based metric; GPU usage isn't wired into the policy. this is bad.

ben_sre: that explains it. We have two misconfigs: 1) max_nodes too low for expected burst, 2) autoscaler trigger ignores GPU load. also token-bucket per-tier was very strict: bucket refill set to 50 rps for enterprise tier (should be 500). I suspect a bad deploy of tier-policy.

ciara_prod: can we patch a temporary fix? Options: raise max_nodes, relax token-bucket rates, enable fallback to compatible smaller model, or divert traffic to dedicated reserved capacity (if available).

eric_oncall: priority order: 1) relax token-buckets for enterprise + critical tiers to reduce 429s, 2) increase max_nodes to 16 (emergency), 3) adjust autoscaler to consider GPU utilization as a metric, 4) enable model-variant fallback for long sequences. I'll start with (1) & (2).

ben_sre: I'll make the token-bucket change and post the `patch` command. doing it via infra-controlplane so it takes effect instantly.

ben_sre: ```
# relax token bucket for enterprise tier
redwoodctl tiers update enterprise --token-refill 500 --token-burst 1000
# verify
redwoodctl tiers get enterprise | jq .token
```

ben_sre: applied. monitoring for 60s.

ciara_prod: I'm seeing 429 count drop for rdx-enterprise already — from 320/min down to ~40/min. customers still have intermittent failures.

jamie_csm: rdx-enterprise confirms partial recovery but reports higher latency (2-4s). they want a note when fully stable.

eric_oncall: initiating emergency scale: bumping max_nodes in the autoscaler group. terraform apply on the autoscaler config (short window).

ben_sre: command: ```
# emergency bump
kubectl -n infra patch hpa gpu-autoscaler -p '{"spec": {"maxReplicas": 16}}'
```

infra_lead: hold — cloud GPU quota in eu-west-1 currently 12/12 allocated across other clusters. we can request quota increase but won't be instant. options: 1) re-route some non-critical workloads to another region, 2) drain idle GPUs used by staging, 3) spin up smaller instance types (v100->a10x) if supported.

eric_oncall: ack. we don't have spare quota. so we need software-side mitigation. enabling model-variant fallback now — switch long-seq requests to gpt-small-quant or streaming-KV-optimized variant.

ben_sre: applying policy change to route long sequences (>2048) to variant fallback: ```
redwoodctl routing add-rule --match "request.seq_len > 2048" --target "gpt-medium-quant" --priority 10
```

ben_sre: rule added. watch for error increase.

ciara_prod: queue length dropping slowly, GPU util down to ~75% on hotpath. 429s continue but trending down.

jamie_csm: flagged to rdx-enterprise that we routed long requests to a slightly smaller variant temporarily; they accepted for now. asking about postmortem.

lina_pm: please capture timeline and customer impact window for postmortem. include impacted orgs, percent of calls failed, and mitigation steps. I'll schedule a follow-up with accounts.

eric_oncall: logging events: 1936007890 initial pager. 1936007925 token-bucket relaxation applied. 1936008000 routing fallback enabled. 1936008120 throttle counts dropped 60%. 1936008600 backlog drained to <200.

ben_sre: small fix to autoscaler config queued as PR: change scale metric to `gpu_utilization` and set cooldowns: scale_out_cooldown=45s, maxReplicas=32 (requires quota). PR link: https://git.redwood/infra/prs/8472 (dm me for review).

infra_lead: I'll open an urgent quota request with cloud support, but estimate 24-72h. we should not rely on quota in future. long term: bring region-local reserve or reserved dedicated pools for enterprise customers.

ciara_prod: monitoring shows residual 429 spike from other small orgs still using older routes. pushing a global token-bucket bump for all paid tiers by 2x for next 30m as temporary.

ben_sre: applied global bump: `redwoodctl tiers patch --all --scale-token 2x --ttl 30m`. watch for downstream cost impact.

jamie_csm: CSMs updated customers; rdx-enterprise and rdx-proto team are OK with temporary routing. some smaller customers complained though — will collate list.

eric_oncall: handoff: I'm going offline in 30m for rotation. next oncall @ben_sre will own the incident. please keep the incident channel updated. I'll create a runbook note and assign postmortem.

ben_sre: taking over. current status: backlog drained, 429 rate down to baseline but latency elevated ~500ms extra. I'll keep watch and follow up on autoscaler PR + quota request.

lina_pm: thank you team. capture any config changes and revert plan for when quota is restored — we should remove the global token bump and routing after proven stability.

ciara_prod: quick todo for postmortem: root cause = mis-specified autoscaler metric + bad tier-policy deploy lowering enterprise token-bucket. impact window: 10:14UTC-10:54UTC (40m). customers impacted: rdx-enterprise (~30% failure peak), rdx-proto (~12% peak), 7 smaller customers with intermittent 429s.

incident-bot: Incident update posted to status.redwood.com; severity set to Sev2. Follow-up: postmortem assigned to ciara_prod.

ben_sre: I'll keep running a reduced token limit and monitor cost. escalating to infra_lead for follow ups on capacity and dedicated reserved pool options.

infra_lead: noted. will draft quota escalation and options doc. also recommend an automated smoke test to detect tier-policy deploy regressions — we should add that to CI.

jamie_csm: closing loop with customers now. will reopen if any further regressions. good job everyone. :thumbsup:
